title: Blocking and unblocking users
summary: Explains how to block and unblock users: block from a user profile (confirm choice) and unblock from the block list (confirm to restore interactions). Notes a $275 maximum blocking limit, and a 12-hour wait before re-blocking a user you just unblocked.
